data.exact_reserve_text: Included within net claims incurred of GBP 82.5m (2016: GBP 81.9m) is a deterioration of GBP 4.2m (2016: deterioration of GBP 10.9m) to claims reserves established at the prior year end principally due to the unfavourable development of Property, Political Risks and European Creditor business.

named_events.loss_description: The Property account was impacted by the Q3 2017 catastrophes resulting in adverse development on the Property account.

data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2017 gross claims outstanding were GBP 87.278m. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle (and reserves notes) indicates net prior-year adverse development (gross strengthening) of approximately GBP 6.8m, driven principally by adverse development on the Property book following Q3 2017 catastrophe activity and by large loss development on casualty/liability exposures. The report also explicitly states a net (after reinsurance) deterioration of GBP 4.2m to claims reserves established at the prior year end.
raw_causal_phrases: deterioration of GBP 4.2m (2016: deterioration of GBP 10.9m) to claims reserves established at the prior year end principally due to the unfavourable development of Property, Political Risks and European Creditor business.

materially adverse performance on the Property account, following the Q3 catastrophes and development on a legacy claim, and the Non-Marine Liability account as a result of two large claims reported in the period.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year gross reserve movement was not stated explicitly as a single gross figure. Gross PYD has been calculated from the reported gross claims development triangle (sum of diagonal changes for underwriting years up to 2015) resulting in approx. +GBP 6.78m (strengthening). The report explicitly states a net (after reinsurance) deterioration of GBP 4.2m; the difference is explainable by movement in reinsurers' share. Some narrative statements around Political Risks are mixed; mapping of classes and attribution is inferred from text. RITC activity (2015 RITC into 2016 closed at 31 Dec 2017) may affect comparability but the triangle used excludes '2010 & Prior' aggregate column.
